info.title: Gradiate API
info.summary: One API for student grades across Home Access Center, PowerSchool and Skyward.
info.description: Gradiate logs into school district portals on a student’s behalf and returns clean JSON. Every platform shares the same route table, request shape, session envelope, streaming protocol and error format.

tags.name: HAC
tags.description: PowerSchool eSchoolPlus Home Access Center, common across Texas districts. Supports direct portal credentials and ClassLink SSO (with PIN/image 2FA).

tags.name: PowerSchool
tags.description: Guardian portal with multi-student parent accounts, date-driven term columns and Microsoft (Azure AD) sign-in via cookie handoff.

tags.name: Skyward Legacy
tags.description: Classic Skyward Student & Family Access. Credentials only; term/subterm tabs are reconstructed from the gradebook itself.

tags.name: Canvas
tags.description: Instructure Canvas, via its documented REST API and a user access token. The only LMS here — no attendance, report cards or transcripts, but assignments are first-class objects with real due dates.

post.description: Given a HAC portal link, reports whether the host fronts several districts. Show a district picker only when `multiple` is true, then send the chosen `name` as `loginData.district`.

400.description: Validation error (bad `loginType`, missing params, unsafe link).

example.message: loginType must be one of: credentials, classlink, classlinkCredentials

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a session envelope.
post.description:
Authenticates only — no data is fetched. A cheap validation probe runs so a bad password or expired session fails here rather than on your next call. Store the returned `session` and send it with every data request.

For ClassLink logins that hit a second factor, this returns `mfaRequired` (HTTP 200, `success: false`) — re-call with the returned `session` and `loginData.clMFA`.

post.summary: Every assignment across every class, with dates (Canvas only).
post.description:
The LMS-only route. A gradebook portal only ever shows assignments underneath a class; Canvas has them as first-class objects with real due / unlock / lock timestamps, submission state and class statistics, so this returns one flat list across every course — enough to render “what’s due this week” without a `/single-class` call per class.

Scope it with `options.term` (a grading period), narrow it to one course with `options.course`, and filter with `options.status`, `options.dueAfter` / `options.dueBefore` and `options.limit`. Results are sorted by due date, soonest first, with undated work last; `counts` always reflects the full match even when `limit` truncates the list.

`description` (Canvas’s HTML body) is omitted unless you ask for it — it is frequently enormous. If a course cannot be read (locked, or rate-limited), the rest still come back and the course is named in `unavailable`.

term.description: Term label from `termList`. Defaults to the current term.

course.description: Course id from `classes[].course` (preferred over `class` when both exist).

class.description: Class name, exactly as returned in `classes[].name`.

status.description: Keep only assignments in these states. One value or a list; `late`, `missing` and `excused` also match the corresponding `badges`, so graded-but-late work still shows up.

dueAfter.description: Keep only assignments due at or after this date.

dueBefore.description: Keep only assignments due at or before this date.

ungraded.description: Set `false` to drop assignments that do not count toward the grade.

includeDescription.description: Include each assignment’s HTML body. Off by default — it is frequently very large.

limit.description: Cap how many assignments are returned, after sorting. `counts` still reflects the full match.

order.description: Sort order. Undated work always sorts last.

includeConcluded.description: Read concluded enrollments instead of active ones.

counts.description: `total` plus a tally per `status`, over every match (not just the returned page).

unavailable.description: Courses whose assignments could not be read. Absent when everything succeeded.

text/event-stream.description: When `stream: true`: newline-delimited progress objects separated by blank lines, followed by the final JSON body.

LoginType.description: How to authenticate. Each platform accepts a subset — see the platform pages.

link.description: Base URL of the district portal. `https://` and a trailing slash are added if missing.

district.description: **HAC only.** District name for multi-district HAC hosts (see `/hac/districts`).

code.description: ClassLink district login code (the `/{code}` in launchpad.classlink.com/{code}).

clMFA.description: Answer to a 2FA challenge: the 6-digit PIN, or the chosen icon filename. Send it on the follow-up call after `mfaRequired`.

cookies.description: Portal cookies captured after Microsoft sign-in. A `Cookie` header string, `[{name,value}]`, or a `{name: value}` map.

TokenLoginData.title: token
TokenLoginData.description: API-token sign-in. The token is the whole credential — there is no handshake and no cookie — so it is sent on every request and round-trips inside the `session` envelope.

link.description: Canvas instance URL, e.g. `https://district.instructure.com`. Any path is stripped.

token.description: A Canvas user access token (Account → Settings → **+ New Access Token**).

Session.description: Opaque session envelope returned by every authenticated route. Send it back unchanged as `session` to skip re-authentication. Sessions validated within the last 5 minutes are reused with no portal round-trip; older ones are probed and transparently re-logged-in.

lastValidationTime.description: Epoch ms of the last successful validation.

loginData.description: Credentials for `loginType`. May be omitted when a fresh `session` is supplied (except for SSO logins, which also need it to re-login).

stream.description: Stream progress updates before the final JSON body. See the Streaming guide.

status.description: HTTP status (included on auth/data route errors).

MfaChallenge.description: Returned with HTTP 200 when a ClassLink login stops at a second factor.

group.description: True for a synthetic letter-family root (e.g. all `P*` terms).

course.description: Course code / id. Use with `options.course` on `/single-class`.

averageType.description: How the portal computes the average: `percentwise`, `scorewise` or `categorywise`.

termName.description: **Canvas.** The enrollment term the course belongs to (`Fall 2026`).

term.description: The term the data is for.

termList.description: Every available term, in portal order.

termTree.description: **PowerSchool / Skyward.** Terms grouped by letter family. **Canvas** returns a flat list (grading periods do not nest).

currentTerms.description: **PowerSchool / Skyward / Canvas.** All terms active today, coarsest first — the last entry is the finest.

StudentContext.description: **PowerSchool only.** Present on every PowerSchool data response.

url.description: Link to the assignment in Canvas.

description.description: Canvas’s HTML body. Only present with `options.includeDescription`.

dueAt.description: Raw ISO instant, for sorting and relative times.

dueDate.description: `M/D/YYYY` in the user’s own Canvas time zone.

daysUntilDue.description: Negative once the due date has passed.

status.description: Where the assignment stands, resolved in the order a student reads it: excused, then graded, then submitted, then the due date. Filter with `options.status`.

grade.description: The score in the assignment’s own scheme (a letter, `complete`, or the number).

pointsDeducted.description: Taken off by the course’s late policy.

statistics.description: Class-wide min/max/mean, when the teacher publishes them.

x-platforms.name: HAC
x-platforms.summary: PowerSchool eSchoolPlus Home Access Center, common across Texas districts. Supports direct portal credentials and ClassLink SSO (with PIN/image 2FA).
notes: A single HAC host can front several districts. Call `/hac/districts` with the portal link and, if `multiple` is true, pass the chosen district name as `loginData.district`.
Classes include full assignment `scores` (`scoresIncluded: true`) — no follow-up `/single-class` call is needed to show assignments.
Terms are flat run numbers (`"1"`–`"6"`); no `termTree` is returned.
`/attendance` accepts `options.date` as `Month-YYYY` (e.g. `March-2026`) to walk the calendar.
`/ipr` (interim progress reports) exists only on HAC.

x-platforms.name: PowerSchool
x-platforms.summary: Guardian portal with multi-student parent accounts, date-driven term columns and Microsoft (Azure AD) sign-in via cookie handoff.
notes: Call `/powerschool/authMethods` first — some districts are credentials-only, others Microsoft-only.
`microsoftSession` login: complete Microsoft sign-in in a browser/WebView, then send the resulting portal cookies as `loginData.cookies`.
Parent accounts: every response carries `students` and the active `studentId`. Pass `options.studentId` to switch child.
`/classes` returns averages only (`scoresIncluded: false`); fetch assignments per class with `/single-class`.
Terms are data-driven (P1/C1/S1/Y1…) and grouped by letter family in `termTree`; `currentTerms` lists every term active today.

x-platforms.name: Skyward Legacy
x-platforms.summary: Classic Skyward Student & Family Access. Credentials only; term/subterm tabs are reconstructed from the gradebook itself.
notes: `link` is the full `WService=…` base URL of the district’s Family Access.
`/classes` returns averages per term (`scoresIncluded: false`); `/single-class` fetches assignments for one term.
Term labels vary by district (PR1/1ST/SM1, T1–T4, Q1–Q4…). Fall/spring sections of the same course are merged.
No SSO login types and no `/ipr`.

x-platforms.name: Canvas
x-platforms.summary: Instructure Canvas, via its documented REST API and a user access token. The only LMS here — no attendance, report cards or transcripts, but assignments are first-class objects with real due dates.
notes: Sign in with `loginType: "token"`. The user generates the token in Canvas under **Account → Settings → + New Access Token**; there is no password and no SSO flow to complete.
`link` is the Canvas instance URL (`https://district.instructure.com`). Any path is discarded, so pasting the URL of whatever page the user was on works.

Terms are Canvas **grading periods** — flat and dated, so `termTree` has no nesting (`hasSubterms: false`). A synthetic `Total` column carries the whole-course grade when the account enables all-grading-period totals, or when there are no grading periods at all.
`/classes` returns averages only (`scoresIncluded: false`); fetch assignments per class with `/single-class`, or across every class at once with `/assignments`.
`/assignments` is Canvas-only: every assignment with due / unlock / lock timestamps, submission state, score and class statistics, filterable by term, course, status and due-date window.
No `/attendance`, `/reportCard`, `/transcript`, `/ipr`, `/schedule` or `/bellSchedule` — Canvas is a learning platform, not a student information system, so those routes return 404.
Teacher emails are not exposed by Canvas’s course payload, so `/teachers` returns `email: ""`.

x-operations.title: Log in
x-operations.summary: Authenticate and receive a session envelope.
x-operations.description:
Authenticates only — no data is fetched. A cheap validation probe runs so a bad password or expired session fails here rather than on your next call. Store the returned `session` and send it with every data request.

For ClassLink logins that hit a second factor, this returns `mfaRequired` (HTTP 200, `success: false`) — re-call with the returned `session` and `loginData.clMFA`.

x-operations.title: List districts
x-operations.description: Given a HAC portal link, reports whether the host fronts several districts. Show a district picker only when `multiple` is true, then send the chosen `name` as `loginData.district`.

x-operations.title: Auth methods
x-operations.summary: Which sign-in methods a district offers (no auth).
x-operations.description: Given a PowerSchool portal link, reports whether it accepts username/password, Microsoft SSO, or both — so you only render the buttons that will work.

x-operations.title: Student info
x-operations.summary: Profile details for the logged-in student.
x-operations.description: Name, school, grade and other registration details. Fields a portal does not expose are returned as empty strings.

x-operations.title: Classes & grades
x-operations.summary: Every class with its average for a term.
x-operations.description:
Returns all classes for a term plus the term metadata needed to render a term picker. Pass `options.term` to switch terms; omit it for the current term.

`scoresIncluded` tells you whether each class already carries its assignments (HAC) or whether you need `/single-class` (PowerSchool, Skyward).

x-operations.title: Single class
x-operations.description: Fetches one class and its assignment scores for a term. Identify the class with `options.class` (name) or, on PowerSchool and Skyward, `options.course` (id — more reliable when two sections share a name).

x-operations.title: Schedule
x-operations.description: The student’s class schedule. On HAC and Skyward each row is keyed by the portal’s own column headers, so keys can vary between districts.

x-operations.title: Bell schedule
x-operations.description: Period timings. PowerSchool groups periods by weekday; Skyward returns one flat list. Returns 404 when the portal has no timed schedule.

x-operations.title: Attendance
x-operations.description: Attendance events keyed by `MM/DD/YYYY`. HAC walks its calendar to `options.date`; PowerSchool and Skyward return the most recent month with data.

x-operations.title: Teachers
x-operations.description: One entry per class with the teacher’s name and email.

x-operations.title: Report cards
x-operations.summary: Report card grades per grading run.
x-operations.description: All published report cards, newest first. Row shapes follow each portal’s report card layout.

x-operations.title: Progress reports
x-operations.description: Every interim progress report with per-course grades and teacher comment codes.

x-operations.title: Transcript
x-operations.description: Completed coursework by year/semester. The exact structure mirrors the portal’s transcript page.
